Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciated the walkthrough of your use cases for patient triage and intake summarization. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC kicked off: 

1) Success criteria (what we’ll measure):
   - Precision/recall for intent classification >= 88% on your labeled triage set
   - Average summary coherence score >= 4.2/5 on a blinded review of 100 summaries
   - 95th percentile response latency < 600ms for short prompts under target throughput

2) Eval dataset & prompts we need from your side: 
   - Prompt set (representative prompts + expected outputs where available) — CSV preferred
   - Chat logs (de-identified) for system behavior reproduction — ZIP fine
   - Any existing evaluation rubrics or example grades

3) Timeline:
   - You send datasets by Wed 2026-06-17
   - Redwood imports + baseline run by Fri 2026-06-19
   - Joint review + scoring week of 2026-06-22

4) Ownership:
   - Acme: Provide datasets + label guide (Samantha, Tom)
   - Redwood: Import, run baseline models, produce eval report (Marissa + Aditya)

5) Next steps:
   - Samantha to share dataset links and any NDA-required filenames
   - I’ll attach our POC eval plan and a sample prompt CSV template for your team to follow.

Attaching: redwood_poc_eval_plan_v1.md (outline + template).

If this looks good I’ll lock in the timeline and schedule a 30-min sync for early next week.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
